description: This file defines the CountryService interface, which extends a generic service for managing Country entities. It declares methods for retrieving countries by code, adding descriptions, and fetching lists or maps of countries based on language and ISO codes.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: A service interface for managing country data, extending generic CRUD operations and adding country-specific methods.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a country entity based on its unique code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Associates a description with a specific country.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Fetches a list of countries available in a specific language.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of country codes to country entities for a given language.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of countries matching provided ISO codes in a specified language.
